description: Eight-rung selectivity ladder for tpch-pname-sf10, picked from tpch-pname-sf10-contains-s42 to be even in log-selectivity (92.23% down to 0.00090%). Truth embedded per-query; binding via dataset checksum only. Extended with a second eight-rung ladder of curated TPC-H Q9 colour predicates: four single colours (all ~0.054, needle lengths 4-10, so needle length varies at fixed selectivity), two colour pairs (~5e-4) and two colour triples (4.5e-6, 1.0e-6).
